channel: epbs/_threads/Blinding payloads to save disk space
searchText: This is an interesting idea. Creating a thread. <@554799849288105986> Are you thinking of making this configurable? cc <@402080271563751435> for visibility Context here is that zk attesters may not have an EL We can certainly do that It's just that right now, all CL clients already do this for forks >= Bellatrix So stopping = increased disk usage makes sense -- seems reasonable to have it as a default so that you don't store redundant data. If its not too much effort, would be great to have it be configurable Yep, I noticed this when running integration tests for our zk attestor lighthouse fork. When RPC block requests are made against zk attestor nodes (with no EL), they fail to fulfil the request and are ultimately penalised. If you could make this configurable, that would be great. Wait do we no longer have a flag to disable this for previous forks? Not sure, I didn't get a chance to check. I can take a look. I hacked around it in the interim by syncing from non zk-attestor nodes in the first instance. Possibly this configuration in the store? ``` /// Whether to prune payloads on initialization and finalization. pub prune_payloads: bool, ``` we already do this blinding i think <@641548687813902336> is basically looking at this currently
